name: Thomas Young & Elizabeth Martin — marriage (1828)
researcher_question: Where and when did Elizabeth Young marry Thomas Young?
notes: The marriage record (Bristol St James, 16 Nov 1828) is the core, required finding; Elizabeth's maiden name Martin (f2) and her christening as Betty Martin (Bitton, 1 Nov 1812, daughter of Thomas & Sophia Martin, f3) are bonus findings, demoted to required:false under step mode (issue #4145) since the question now asks only about the marriage. Evidence includes a GRO birth-index confirmation via Ancestry and Findmypast (non-FamilySearch) plus the FamilySearch marriage register image — note that one part of the research document gives 1829 erroneously while the Research Summary authoritative section says 16 November 1828, which is the correct value.
